  <action>At every action and gate, rediscover `PLAN68_ROOT` using the exact one-result direct-child `os.scandir` predicate, export it only to that child command, replay `allocation.json`, `expected-authority.json`, and the independently reconstructed Plan45–67 inventories against current `lstat`, compare only the root's stable `path,type,mode,uid,gid,dev,inode` identity after the lifecycle gate, and require every referenced Plan 68 path resolves by `realpath` beneath that root.
